principles: N1000-N10000 are carried forward unchanged from expert_0.4.0.
N11000 reads FEATURE-02 strict-past history only; current, same-date and future matches never enter its historical evidence.
Consistency is not classified as high/low or good/bad: the exact prior population standard deviation is exposed when evaluable.
Trend is not classified as improving/declining: the exact prior OLS slope is exposed when evaluable.
At least two prior non-null observations are mathematically required for prior_std and prior_slope; this is an operator requirement, not a performance threshold.
No score, weight, percentile, cross-player ranking, practical-significance cutoff or recommendation is introduced.
confidence=1.0 means deterministic execution of the evidence rule, not calibrated performance probability.

node_patterns.description: Exact population standard deviation over prior non-null observations.
Exact OLS slope over prior non-null observations.
